# Try Omarchy v1.0.0

The first stable Try Omarchy for Windows release. Download **TryOmarchy.exe** below and run it on Windows x64. Existing preview installations keep their guest disk, files, and settings. The signed updater uses the v0.0.20-preview bridge for older launchers; the new launcher can then install v1.0.0.

- Open Settings before boot from the new launcher, then select **Launch Omarchy**. Optional Start-menu and Desktop shortcuts can start Omarchy directly while preserving a separate Settings shortcut.
- Select playback and microphone devices for the next boot. If a saved device disappears, audio falls back to the Windows default.
- Use Alt+Tab inside the focused Omarchy window; Ctrl+Alt+Tab opens the Windows task switcher.
- Use the existing camera, microphone, clipboard, folder sharing, file drops, snapshots, backups, recovery, and GPU rendering with CPU fallback.
- Hosts that support nested virtualization can run nested Linux workloads; unsupported hosts continue to boot Omarchy normally.

The Precision Touchpad pinch bridge is experimental and disabled by default. Live audio switching, Windows Hello sudo, bridged networking, battery mirroring, live RAM reclamation, and Windows ARM64 are outside this release. Graphics support depends on the Windows driver; the launcher can use CPU rendering when GPU acceleration is unavailable. An earlier NVIDIA runtime failed Vulkan initialization on one tested PC; see the [compatibility guide](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy-windows/blob/master/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) for that result and current workarounds.

Use **Update > Omarchy** inside the guest to update Linux packages. Launcher updates preserve the writable guest disk.

[Changes since v0.0.20-preview](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy-windows/compare/v0.0.20-preview...v1.0.0)
